crecimiento.chipCalma: Calm day · your sprout grew twice as much

logrosAccess.title: Achievements
logrosAccess.unseen_one: You have 1 new achievement to see
logrosAccess.unseen_other: You have {{count}} new achievements to see

nota.text: Every expense you log speeds up your sprout's growth. Complete the 7 days and your garden blooms. No spending? Mark the day and your sprout grows twice as much.

perfecta.label: Perfect week
perfecta.title: Your garden bloomed.
perfecta.sub: You logged all 7 days. Every sprout reached its peak.

buena.label: Great week
buena.title: Almost perfect.
buena.sub: Most of your sprouts matured. You were a little short of a full garden.

floja.label: Slow week
floja.title: Your garden held on.
floja.sub: A few sprouts made it through. One more week like this and they'll fully mature.

cortada.label: Lost week
cortada.title: Your streak broke.
cortada.sub: Your record and your garden are still safe. Plant again whenever you want.

cierre.coachFloja: Come back tomorrow: today's sprout can still bloom. One day at a time.
cierre.coachCortada: Your record ({{record}}) and your garden ({{garden}}) are still safe. Plant today and start again.

noSpend.headline: No spending today — streak protected
noSpend.message: You marked the day as "no spending". The streak stays active at {{level}}, and every counted day adds to your progress.

nearLevel.headline: Almost at {{level}}!
nearLevel.message_one: Just {{count}} more day to level up. Keep it up.
nearLevel.message_other: Just {{count}} more days to level up. Keep it up.

active.message: You're at {{level}}. Every day you log, your money works better for you.

atRiskWithShield.message_one: {{tone}} You have {{count}} shield available — if you don't log today, just one is used at midnight.
atRiskWithShield.message_other: {{tone}} You have {{count}} shields available — if you don't log today, just one is used at midnight.

atRiskNoShield.message_one: {{tone}} You're at {{count}} day — no shields, so if you don't log it breaks and tomorrow you start from zero.
atRiskNoShield.message_other: {{tone}} You're at {{count}} days — no shields, so if you don't log it breaks and tomorrow you start from zero.

broken.headline: The streak broke
broken.messageWithRecord_one: Your personal best is still {{count}} day. Log an entry today and start a new one.
broken.messageWithRecord_other: Your personal best is still {{count}} days. Log an entry today and start a new one.
broken.messageFresh: A new streak starts with a single entry. Log today and you're on day 1.

calm.atRiskHeadlineWithShield: Good day — your streak is still alive
calm.atRiskMessage: You've got the whole day ahead — log whenever you can.

gentle.atRiskHeadlineWithShield: Your streak is still in play
gentle.atRiskMessage: Good moment to jot down the day's expense before it gets late.

urgent.atRiskHeadlineNoShield: Just a few hours until midnight
urgent.atRiskMessage: If you log now, you'll avoid any last-minute scramble.

critical.atRiskMessage: Log now to close out the day without losing progress.
